title: Machine learning on protein-per-mRNA ratios supports tissue-specific codon optimization
summary: Protein-to-mRNA ratios of 36 human tissues from GTEx and the Human Protein Atlas were used to train per-tissue random forest models of codon preferences, revealing two tissue clusters with opposite codon patterns. These underpin CUSTOM, a codon optimizer, and genes designed with it showed tissue-optimized expression in human cell-line models. Proof of concept in cell lines; effect sizes were not read.
ai_technology: Random forest models of codon enrichment per tissue, basis of the CUSTOM optimizer
organization: Barcelona Institute of Science and Technology; Centre for Genomic Regulation
